name: tidyrun
description: Local-first optimization runtime for AI coding agents. No extra model.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tidyrun/core && npm run build -w @tidyrun/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @tidyrun/cli && npm run build -w tidyrun
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/main.js benchmark benchmarks/output-reduction.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tidyrun/core && npm run test -w @tidyrun/plugin-sdk && npm run test -w @tidyrun/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tidyrun/core && npm run typecheck -w @tidyrun/plugin-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @tidyrun/cli
